description: The shared vaults anyone may join, on every venue (today: the Hyperliquid vault on HyperEVM testnet, test money): each one's NAV, shares, whether it prices right now, the agent that trades its venue account, its positions, the strategy it copies (a strategy measured on the time compressor, the desk of the Taifoon book that trades it, the ratio and the cap per pass), its caps, the bridge that brings money to it, and, with wallet, that wallet's invite, shares, their worth and what it can claim. Read only.

wallet.description: optional: a 0x wallet to read its own invite, shares and claimable assets

name: shared_vaults
